At Techversant, we build AI-driven business solutions for global clients. We are looking for a Lead – AI Engineering & Enablement to advance AI-assisted development and testing across our client engagements.
You will work with our AI specialists, developers, QA professionals and client engineering teams to integrate AI tools into project workflows, build reusable utilities and translate technical capabilities into measurable delivery improvements.
This role combines hands-on engineering with technical coaching and close collaboration with client teams in North America.
What you’ll do:
•Implement and refine AI-assisted workflows across development, code review, self-testing and quality assurance.
•Configure and extend Claude Code, OpenAI Codex and related tools using skills, hooks, Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations and agent workflows.
•Build scripts, integrations and reusable utilities that simplify engineering tasks.
•Help QA teams apply AI to test-case design, test review, test-data preparation and automation.
•Collaborate with technical owners on shared QA tooling and cloud-based execution environments.
•Own tool rollout, setup validation and troubleshooting across supported development environments, including Windows and WSL.
•Conduct practical workshops, individual coaching and technical office hours tailored to project needs.
•Create onboarding resources, workflow guides and reusable configurations.
•Gather feedback, identify improvement opportunities and coordinate implementation with engineering and AI teams.
•Track team-level adoption and assess improvements in quality, testing efficiency, rework and delivery turnaround.
•Promote appropriate validation of AI-generated outputs and adherence to project security and data-handling requirements.

What you’ll bring:
•A strong background in software development or QA automation, with the ability
to build and debug tools.
•Regular, hands-on use of Claude Code, OpenAI Codex or comparable AI coding
agents.
•Practical knowledge of skills, hooks, MCP integrations, context management and
iterative agent workflows.
•Proficiency in a programming or scripting language for developing utilities and
integrations.
•Sound understanding of Git, code review, testing and software delivery practices.
•Experience troubleshooting development environments and tool configurations.
•Demonstrated ability to mentor technical teams and explain concepts clearly to people
with different experience levels.
•Strong communication, documentation and stakeholder coordination skills.
•Availability to work from our Trivandrum office, with planned overlap for
collaboration with North American teams.
Good to have:
•Experience introducing AI-assisted workflows in live engineering environments.
•Exposure to developer productivity, technical enablement or engineering consulting.
•Familiarity with test automation frameworks, cloud environments and workflow
measurement.
•Experience collaborating with international clients and distributed teams.
You will contribute to Techversant’s AI engineering practice, work on practical challenges across global engagements and build tools and approaches that teams can reuse at scale.

full_job_description:
Brief Description
Digital Marketing Lead
Location:
In-office, Technopark, Trivandrum, Kerala
Working hours:
UK business hours (approx. 1:30 PM to 10:30 PM IST)
Employment type:
Full-time
Compensation:
Competitive, based on experience
About the Role
ImmiWorks India is the in-house delivery centre for an established UK group with over a decade of trading history and a strong reputation for client service. We are a young operation but not a start-up gamble. You get the stability, standards, and backing of a mature firm together with the energy and ownership of building a capability from the ground up.
We are building the marketing function that will drive growth across the group’s UK immigration service lines: corporate work (sponsor licence applications, compliance, audits and renewals) and individual work (visa renewals, ILR, naturalisation, and new subscription products).
The way our clients research is changing. More of the early, top-of-funnel questions that used to start on Google are now answered by AI Overviews, AI Mode, ChatGPT and similar tools, and we want to be the firm those answers draw on and cite.
This is a lead role, not a specialist one. Your first priority is building our visibility across traditional and AI search, hands-on: technical fixes, on-page work, content strategy and authority. Around that, you own how the digital channel performs as a whole: landing page conversion, analytics and attribution, direction of the paid media, and the wider digital mix. We need someone who has done this before, can show the before-and-after numbers, and is still hands-on enough to do the work rather than describe it.
You will be based at our Technopark office in Trivandrum, working in real-time alignment with UK business hours.
What You’ll Be Doing
Organic and AI search
•
Auditing where we stand across technical health, content, authority and AI visibility, and turning that into a prioritised 12-month search roadmap with targets the business can track.
•
Owning technical SEO: crawlability and indexation, site architecture, Core Web Vitals and page speed, structured data (schema), canonicals, redirects and sitemaps. Writing clear fix specifications and working with developers until fixes are shipped, not just listed.
•
Owning on-page SEO: keyword and search-intent mapping to service pages, titles, headings and internal linking, and the E-E-A-T signals that matter in a regulated legal topic (author credentials, solicitor review, sources and freshness).
•
Setting the content strategy around topic ownership: deciding which immigration topics we must own, building topic clusters and pillar pages, closing gaps against competitors, and refreshing or consolidating content that underperforms. Briefing writers and our lawyers, and editing for search without compromising legal accuracy.
•
Owning off-page and authority building: auditing and cleaning up the existing backlink profile, and earning quality links and mentions through digital PR, legal and HR publications, credible directories and partner sites. Quality over volume, and no link schemes.
•
Owning our visibility in AI search (GEO/AEO): how we appear in Google AI Overviews and AI Mode, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Copilot. Structuring content so it is clear, quotable and citable, strengthening entity and brand signals (Google Business Profile, consistent citations, reviews, third-party mentions), and tracking AI visibility and AI referral traffic over time.
Conversion and measurement
•
Owning conversion at page level: page structure, messaging hierarchy, calls to action, trust signals and form friction on service and landing pages. Using A/B tests, heatmaps and session recordings to find and fix where enquiries are being lost.
•
Owning measurement: GA4, Google Tag Manager, Search Console, UTMs, conversion tracking and CRM attribution, so every enquiry can be traced to its source, including organic and AI referrals.
•
Reporting to UK leadership on visibility, traffic, enquiries, pipeline and cost per acquisition by channel and by service line, with a clear view on where the next pound of effort and budget should go.
Wider digital marketing
•
Taking a service line brief from the UK team and turning it into a costed, multi-channel plan with clear targets (lead volume, cost per lead, conversion rate, ROAS).
•
Directing paid media currently run by an external agency across Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn and Meta: setting objectives, reviewing structure, spend and results, and making sure paid and organic work together on keywords, landing pages and remarketing. Over time, advising and planning to bring this in-house.
•
Planning organic socials and directing the video and content pipeline, briefing what gets made based on what is performing and what supports search.
•
Overseeing email and CRM marketing: segmentation, nurture sequences, renewal and cross-sell campaigns, and clean handover of qualified leads into sales.
•
Supporting PR, thought leadership and partner marketing, with an eye on the authority, links and citations they generate.
Preferred Skills
Required Experience
•
5+ years in digital marketing, with SEO as a core part of your role for at least three of them (in-house or agency), and time owning results independently or leading the work.
•
A proven organic growth track record. You have taken a site with weak traffic and authority and grown it, and can walk us through the before and after: traffic, rankings, enquiries, and what you did to get there.
•
Hands-on technical SEO. You can run and interpret a crawl (Screaming Frog, Sitebulb or similar), diagnose issues in Search Console, implement schema, and write a fix specification a developer can act on.
•
Content strategy built in practice: keyword research, intent mapping, topic clusters, briefs and content refreshes that measurably moved results.
•
Ethical link building. You have audited and improved a backlink profile and earned quality links through digital PR, outreach or partnerships, and you know what not to do.
•
Practical, current experience in AI search (GEO/AEO): you have worked on visibility in AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity or similar, and can explain what you changed and how you measured it. The field is new, so we value evidenced experimentation over claimed expertise.
•
Strong in GA4, GTM, Search Console and conversion tracking, and comfortable with page-level CRO and A/B testing. You make decisions on evidence, not instinct.
•
Enough hands-on paid media experience (Google Ads at minimum) to audit an agency’s account, challenge their decisions and integrate paid with organic.
•
Strong written English in a clear, professional UK register for a B2B audience. You will be shaping content that has to rank, be cited, and stay legally accurate.
•
Able to brief, manage and hold agencies, freelancers and developers to their output.
•
Service industry background. Professional services or a regulated sector (legal, immigration, consultancy, finance) is a strong advantage.
Desirable
•
SEO experience in a YMYL sector (legal, finance, health) where E-E-A-T and accuracy carry extra weight.
•
Experience marketing to UK or US audiences, including local search.
•
Familiarity with compliance-driven B2B buyers: HR directors, in-house counsel, business owners.
•
Experience running B2B and B2C campaigns within the same business. We do both.
•
Tooling: SEMrush or Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, Microsoft Clarity or Hotjar, AI visibility tracking tools, and Zoho CRM.
•
Working knowledge of email automation and CRM-driven marketing.
•
Experience building a marketing function rather than joining a finished one.
•
Comfort working with AI-generated video and avatar content.
How We Work
You will be office-based at Technopark, Trivandrum, on full UK business hours, giving you real-time overlap with the UK team for briefings, approvals and decisions. The UK team sets brand, positioning and service strategy, and signs off anything client-facing for legal accuracy. Within that, search, conversion and digital execution are yours. We are building this function from the ground up, so you will have real ownership, a direct line to the people making the decisions, and the scope to grow as the function does.
How to Apply
Send your application to
hr@immiworks.com
•
Your CV and LinkedIn profile.
•
A short note on why this role interests you.
•
One organic growth case study: the starting position, what you changed (technical, content, authority, AI visibility), over what timeline, and what it returned in traffic, visibility and enquiries. Numbers matter more than narrative here.
We filter hard on signal. Show us results you owned and can evidence, not just activity.

Brief Description
Brief Description
Location: Technopark, Thiruvananthapuram
Experience: 0–1 year (final-semester students are also welcomed)
Employment Type: Full-time
Salary: 25-30 K per month
We are looking for a curious, research-oriented individual with a background in Psychology, Behavioural Science or Cognitive Science who can turn research findings into practical solutions.The role focuses on understanding how engineers think, feel and behave toward AI, identifying the barriers to AI adoption, and helping turn AI usage into a consistent daily habit.
A background in any one of these fields is sufficient; a combination of all three is not required. Mindset matters most.
We are looking for someone who does not stop at research or theoretical explanations. You should be able to translate findings into actionable interventions, help implement them, measure their effectiveness and draw clear, evidence-based conclusions.
Key Responsibilities
1. Behavioural Assessment – Psychology
Assist in designing and conducting behavioural assessments, including scoring and interpreting results using appropriate methods.
Identify the fears, doubts, beliefs and motivations that influence how different engineer personas respond to AI.
Help document behavioural patterns and translate assessment findings into actionable insights.
2. Understanding How People Think – Cognitive Science
Study how engineers learn, interact with and use AI tools in their daily work.
Explore when engineers trust, question, resist or ignore AI-generated outputs.
Identify patterns in learning, decision-making and problem-solving that influence AI adoption.
3. Behaviour Change & Intervention – Behavioural Science
Help design and implement persona-specific interventions to improve AI adoption.
Support experiments and practical initiatives that encourage consistent AI usage.
Track behavioural changes over time using observations, feedback and usage data.
Compare outcomes before and after interventions and recommend improvements based on the findings.
4. Research-to-Action & Reporting
Convert observations into clear hypotheses that can be tested using data.
Support the implementation of research findings
Document results, identify what works and what does not, and communicate clear, decision-ready conclusions.
Refine approaches when evidence shows that an intervention is not effective.
Educational Qualifications
A bachelor's or master's degree in any one of the following fields (Final-semester students from the above disciplines are welcome to apply.)
Psychology (Organisational, Applied, Cognitive, Counselling or any other specialisation)
Behavioural Science or Behavioural Economics
Cognitive Science
Added Advantage
Certification or coursework in behavioural science, behavioural economics, psychometrics or change management.
Research experience through a dissertation, thesis, academic project or publication.
Familiarity with surveys, behavioural assessments, qualitative research or basic data analysis.

About Way.com
Way.com is building the super app for car owners: one place to park, insure, wash, fuel, charge, finance, repair and get roadside help for your car. We have been featured for two consecutive years (2022 and 2023) in a16z's Marketplace 100, the list of the largest consumer-facing marketplace startups and private companies (https://a16z.com/marketplace-100/). Way Repair Tech, our AI-powered shop management and growth platform for independent repair shops, is a recipient of the 2026 MOTOR Top 20 Award from MOTOR Information Systems, which recognizes innovative solutions advancing the automotive aftermarket.
What makes Way unusual is the breadth of the problem space. We run eight consumer verticals on the Way app and web, a growing portfolio of B2B SaaS products that help parking operators, car washes, repair shops, insurance agencies and roadside providers run their businesses, and B2B2C experiences that connect the two, where the tools we give our partners power the experience their customers get. Very few product teams get to work across all three models at once.
About the Role
As a Product Manager at Way, you will own a product area end to end: the strategy, the roadmap, the launches and the numbers. You will work closely with engineering, design, data, marketing and operations, and you will have real influence on how the business grows.
We are also becoming an
AI-native product organization
. That means two things. First, the products we build increasingly use AI and LLMs at their core, from intelligent pricing and personalization to agentic workflows for our partners. Second, the way we build is changing: our PMs use AI every day to research, prototype, analyze data and ship faster. You will help shape both.
This is a role for someone who wants their work to be visible in the business, not buried in a backlog.
What You'll Do
• Own a product area end to end.
Define the vision, long-term roadmap and success metrics, and be accountable for outcomes such as growth, conversion, retention, revenue and partner adoption.
• Build across B2C, B2B and B2B2C.
Design consumer experiences, SaaS workflows for business customers, and the connected experiences between them.
• Ship AI-powered features.
Identify where AI and LLMs can create real value for users and partners, define the use case and quality bar, work with engineering on evaluation, and iterate based on how it performs in production.
• Use AI in how you work.
Use AI tools to accelerate discovery, competitive research, PRDs, prototypes and data analysis, and help raise the bar for the team.
• Discover and validate.
Work with data and user research to understand customer and partner behavior, turn insights into hypotheses, and run experiments (including A/B tests) to decide what to build.
• Drive execution.
Own and prioritize the backlog, write clear requirements, and work with engineering and design to deliver high-quality releases on time.
• Take it to market.
Partner with marketing, sales and operations on launches, adoption and enablement, including product documentation and training for internal teams and partners.
• Know the market.
Track competitors and best-in-class products across mobility, marketplaces and vertical SaaS, and bring those lessons back into the roadmap.
• Align stakeholders.
Build shared understanding of priorities with leadership, internal teams and external partners, and communicate clearly on trade-offs and progress.
What You'll Bring
• 5+ years of product management experience, with a track record of shipping products that moved business metrics.
• Experience building consumer (B2C) products, and the curiosity to work across B2B and B2B2C products as well.
• Hands-on use of AI tools in your day-to-day work, and a practical understanding of how AI/LLM features are built, evaluated and improved.
• Strong analytical skills: comfortable with funnels, cohorts and experiment results, and able to query and interpret data yourself (SQL or analytics tools).
• Experience defining roadmaps, running experiments and turning learnings into product decisions.
• Good product instincts balanced with data, and the ability to make sound calls in ambiguous situations.
• Working knowledge of Agile development and enough technical understanding to have credible conversations with engineers about systems, APIs and trade-offs.
• Excellent written and verbal communication, including clear specs and crisp presentations.
• Bachelor's degree in Engineering; an MBA from a reputed institution is preferred.
Preferred Skills
Nice to Have
• Experience with marketplaces, mobility, automotive, parking, insurance or fintech products.
• Experience with vertical SaaS, partner or merchant platforms, or B2B2C models.
• Experience shipping an LLM-powered or agentic feature to production.
• Experience with dynamic pricing, personalization or growth loops.
Why Join Us
• Impact you can see.
You will be part of a small, high-ownership product team whose decisions show up directly in revenue, growth and customer experience.
• Breadth few roles offer.
B2C, B2B and B2B2C products across multiple verticals, all in one company.
• Build the AI-native future.
Work on AI and AI-native products as we build them, and learn by doing.
• Room to grow.
Work closely with product leadership and grow your scope as you prove yourself.
We move fast, learn as we go and value people who take ownership of problems end to end. We work from the office because we believe close collaboration makes us faster. If that sounds like you, we would love to meet.

Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced Android AOSP Hardware Enablement Engineer to bring up and enable automotive hardware platforms for Android Open Source Project (AOSP) and Android Automotive OS (AAOS) builds.
The engineer will be responsible for enabling the underlying hardware and software stack required to build, boot, and operate Android on an automotive SoC platform. This includes bootloader configuration, Linux kernel integration, device tree development, vendor BSP integration, hardware driver enablement, Android build configuration, and debugging of hardware-related boot and runtime issues.
The candidate will work closely with SoC vendors, hardware teams, BSP developers, kernel engineers, and Android framework teams to deliver a stable and functional Android infotainment platform.
Key Responsibilities
AOSP Build System and Platform Integration
Set up and maintain AOSP source code and development environments.
Configure and execute Android platform builds using Soong, Android.bp, Make, and related build tools.
Integrate vendor-provided Android BSP packages into the AOSP source tree.
Configure product definitions, device configurations, board configurations, and vendor-specific build components.
Develop and maintain device-specific build configurations, including device/, vendor/, and relevant kernel integration components.
Configure product makefiles, product packages, build variants, and system/vendor partition requirements.
Resolve build failures, dependency issues, missing modules, and compilation errors.
Maintain build scripts and documentation for repeatable platform builds.
Bootloader and Platform Bring-Up
Enable the Android boot process on new or existing automotive hardware platforms.
Work with bootloaders such as U-Boot or vendor-specific implementations based on the target SoC.
Configure boot arguments, boot targets, image loading, memory reservations, and device tree handoff.
Coordinate with SoC vendors to resolve platform-specific boot and firmware issues.
Linux Kernel and Device Tree Enablement
Integrate and configure vendor Linux kernels compatible with the selected Android release.
Enable required kernel configurations and device drivers for the target hardware.
Develop, modify, and debug Device Tree Source (DTS/DTSI) files and overlays.
Configure hardware resources such as GPIOs, clocks, regulators, interrupts, IOMMU, DMA, and memory regions.
Integrate vendor kernel modules and troubleshoot module loading or dependency issues.
Hardware Driver and Peripheral Enablement
Enable and validate the hardware peripherals required for an automotive infotainment system, including:
Display interfaces such as MIPI DSI, eDP, LVDS, or HDMI, depending on the platform.
Touchscreen controllers and input devices.
Audio codecs, I²S/TDM interfaces, amplifiers, and audio routing dependencies.
USB host/device controllers, storage, and peripheral connectivity.
Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, GNSS, and Ethernet interfaces.
Camera interfaces and sensor connectivity, where applicable.
I²C, SPI, UART, GPIO, PCIe, and other SoC peripherals.
Automotive CAN interfaces and related transceivers, where supported by the platform.
Power management ICs, thermal sensors, watchdogs, and suspend/resume functionality.
Hardware Debugging and System Validation
Debug the complete boot flow from bootloader to Android launcher.
Analyze bootloader logs, kernel dmesg, Android Logcat, tombstones, and service startup logs.
Use ADB, fastboot, serial consoles, JTAG, and hardware debugging tools as available.
Automotive Platform Integration
Enable and validate Android Automotive OS on automotive infotainment reference boards and target hardware.
Work with automotive SoC platforms and vendor BSPs from suppliers such as Qualcomm, NXP, or MediaTek, depending on project requirements.

: Full-time, customer-facing
Ready to start right away? We’re looking for a sales enthusiast who can jump straight in and drive this role forward with passion and energy.
Why this role is different
Most entry-level jobs bury you in tickets and targets. This one doesn't. You'll be the face and voice of Offrd — an AI-powered HR platform used by hundreds of Indian businesses. Your job is simple: talk to customers, show them what our product can do, help them succeed, and build relationships that last.
The workload is light. The impact is not. You'll get direct exposure to the founder, real customers, and real business decisions from day one — the kind of learning that takes years in a big company.
What you'll actually do
• Be the voice of Offrd — run product demos on Zoom/Meet, welcome new customers, and make them feel at home.
• Chat, call, connect — answer customer questions over calls and chat, and turn confused users into happy fans.
• Show off the good stuff — introduce customers to premium features and help them see the value in upgrading.
• Network like a pro — build genuine relationships with HR and business owners across India.
• Be the customer's champion — pass feedback to the product team and help shape what we build next.
Who we're looking for
• A natural people person — you genuinely enjoy conversations, not just tolerate them.
• Excellent communicator — fluent, confident spoken English (Hindi is a big plus for our North Indian customers).
• Dynamic and self-driven — you don't wait to be told; you spot opportunities and go after them.
• Product-passionate — you love exploring apps, understanding how they work, and explaining them simply.
• Calm under pressure — when a customer reports a problem, you solve it with a smile, not a panic.
• Fresher or up to 1year of experience — in customer success, sales, support, demos, or anything people-facing. Attitude matters more than your resume.
One honest thing you should know
Our customers are business owners and HR teams — and they sometimes need us in the evenings or on weekends. So this role needs someone happy to take a call or reply to a chat outside 9-to-6 hours. In return, the overall workload is genuinely light, and we're flexible with you too. If you see "always reachable, rarely overloaded" as a fair trade, we'll get along great.
What's in it for you
• Fast-track learning: work directly with the founder and core team of a growing SaaS startup.
• Real ownership: your customers, your relationships, your wins.
• A career springboard: this role grows into customer success leadership, product, or growth roles.
• A product people actually use: see your work make a difference for real businesses every single day.
Preferred Skills
Sound like you?
Don't overthink the application. Send us your resume with 2–3 lines on why you love talking to people that tells us more than any certificate.

Brief Description
We are seeking an Android Audio Framework Engineer with strong, hands-on expertise in the Android audio framework to develop, customize, and integrate audio software for automotive platforms. The role is framework-focused: you will own audio behavior across AudioService, the audio policy layer, AudioFlinger, and the Android Automotive car audio stack, and integrate it with the Audio HAL and vendor components to deliver reliable, high-quality in-vehicle audio experiences.
Preferred Skills
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, customize, and maintain Android audio framework components (AudioService, AudioPolicyService/AudioPolicyManager, AudioFlinger) for automotive systems.
Implement and customize Android Automotive audio features in CarAudioService, including audio zones, volume groups, audio contexts, and car audio focus management.
Configure and maintain audio routing and policy (audio_policy_configuration.xml, car_audio_configuration.xml, engine configuration), including dynamic and multi-zone routing.
Implement audio focus, ducking, muting, and concurrency handling for automotive use cases such as media, navigation, voice assistant, phone calls, chimes, and safety alerts.
Map AudioAttributes usages to car audio contexts and output devices, and manage volume curves and volume group behavior.
Integrate framework features with the Audio HAL, AudioControl HAL, audio effects, and vendor components through AIDL/HIDL interfaces.
Debug and resolve complex audio issues (routing, focus, volume, latency, glitches, underruns) across the audio framework, audioserver, and HAL layers.
Support system integration, testing, and audio performance tuning.
Document framework design decisions, changes, and troubleshooting guidance.
Required Qualifications
4–8 years of relevant experience in Android audio or embedded software development, with significant hands-on work in the Android audio framework.
In-depth knowledge of the Android audio architecture: AudioService, AudioManager, AudioPolicyService/AudioPolicyManager, AudioFlinger (playback/record/mixer threads), and audioserver.
Strong understanding of audio focus, AudioAttributes and stream types, volume management, audio routing, and audio policy configuration.
Hands-on experience with client APIs and data paths: AudioTrack, AudioRecord, AAudio, MediaPlayer/ExoPlayer, and the audio effects framework.
Strong C/C++ and Java skills for Android framework and native service development.
Working knowledge of Binder/AIDL, Audio HAL (AIDL/HIDL) interfaces, and how the framework interacts with the HAL.
Experience with AOSP builds, framework modification and integration (Android.bp, SELinux), and system-level debugging.
B.Tech/BE in Computer Science and Engineering (CSE) or Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE), or equivalent.
Strong problem-solving and communication skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Hands-on experience with Android Automotive OS audio: CarAudioService, CarAudioManager, audio zones, volume groups, and dynamic routing via audio policy mixes.
Experience with multi-zone and multi-user audio (e.g., rider/passenger or front/rear zones) and external audio sources such as tuner, Bluetooth, and USB.
Familiarity with Bluetooth audio profiles (A2DP, HFP) and their integration with the audio framework.
Exposure to lower layers (ALSA/tinyalsa, audio DSP such as Qualcomm AudioReach/ADSP, codecs) for end-to-end debugging.
Experience with latency and performance tuning and with tools such as ADB, logcat, dumpsys media.audio_flinger / media.audio_policy / audio / car_service, and Perfetto/systrace.

full_job_description:
Brief Description
Location: Technopark, Thiruvananthapuram
Experience: 0–1 year (final-semester students are also welcomed)
Employment Type: Full-time
Salary: 25-30 K per month
We are looking for a curious, research-oriented individual with a background in Psychology, Behavioural Science or Cognitive Science who can turn research findings into practical solutions.The role focuses on understanding how engineers think, feel and behave toward AI, identifying the barriers to AI adoption, and helping turn AI usage into a consistent daily habit.
A background in any one of these fields is sufficient; a combination of all three is not required. Mindset matters most.
We are looking for someone who does not stop at research or theoretical explanations. You should be able to translate findings into actionable interventions, help implement them, measure their effectiveness and draw clear, evidence-based conclusions.
Key Responsibilities
1. Behavioural Assessment – Psychology
Assist in designing and conducting behavioural assessments, including scoring and interpreting results using appropriate methods.
Identify the fears, doubts, beliefs and motivations that influence how different engineer personas respond to AI.
Help document behavioural patterns and translate assessment findings into actionable insights.
2. Understanding How People Think – Cognitive Science
Study how engineers learn, interact with and use AI tools in their daily work.
Explore when engineers trust, question, resist or ignore AI-generated outputs.
Identify patterns in learning, decision-making and problem-solving that influence AI adoption.
3. Behaviour Change & Intervention – Behavioural Science
Help design and implement persona-specific interventions to improve AI adoption.
Support experiments and practical initiatives that encourage consistent AI usage.
Track behavioural changes over time using observations, feedback and usage data.
Compare outcomes before and after interventions and recommend improvements based on the findings.
4. Research-to-Action & Reporting
Convert observations into clear hypotheses that can be tested using data.
Support the implementation of research findings
Document results, identify what works and what does not, and communicate clear, decision-ready conclusions.
Refine approaches when evidence shows that an intervention is not effective.
Educational Qualifications
A bachelor's or master's degree in any one of the following fields (Final-semester students from the above disciplines are welcome to apply.)
Psychology (Organisational, Applied, Cognitive, Counselling or any other specialisation)
Behavioural Science or Behavioural Economics
Cognitive Science
Added Advantage
Certification or coursework in behavioural science, behavioural economics, psychometrics or change management.
Research experience through a dissertation, thesis, academic project or publication.
Familiarity with surveys, behavioural assessments, qualitative research or basic data analysis.
Preferred Skills
Mindset & Skills
Research-to-Action Mindset

full_job_description:
Brief Description
Join our data team to build reliable data pipelines using Azure and Databricks, collaborate with U.S.-based stakeholders, and apply AI-assisted engineering practices. Own Azure Databricks pipelines from requirements through production support. Partner directly with U.S.-based stakeholders, source-system owners, and BI developers to deliver secure, reliable datasets for enterprise reporting and analytics.
RESPONSIBILITIES
•  Pipelines & Ingestion: Independently build database, file, and API ingestion into ADLS Gen2 and Azure Databricks; implement incremental loads, change data capture where appropriate, and safe reprocessing.
•  Transformations & Modeling: Develop SQL and Python/PySpark transformations and Delta Lake tables; build bronze, silver, and gold layers and analytics-ready models with clear data contracts.
•  Reliability & Orchestration: Schedule dependencies through Databricks Jobs or Azure Data Factory; implement validation, monitoring, alerts, retries, and recovery procedures to meet agreed data freshness targets.
•  Security & Delivery: Apply Unity Catalog access controls and lineage, use Azure Key Vault or approved secret management, and deliver automated tests and CI/CD releases through Git-based review.
•  Performance & Partnership: Tune Spark jobs, queries, and table layout for performance and cost; gather requirements with U.S.-based stakeholders and document mappings, quality rules, and operational runbooks.
•  AI-Assisted Engineering: Use approved AI tools to assist with SQL/Python development, testing, troubleshooting, and documentation; validate generated code and outputs and protect client data.
Preferred Skills
Experience ranges are indicative; equivalent demonstrated capability will be considered.
•  Required - Experience: Typical range: 3-5 years in data engineering, including 2+ years delivering Azure Databricks solutions. Demonstrate independent pipeline delivery from requirements through deployment and production support.
•  Required - Core Skills: Strong SQL, Python/PySpark, Delta Lake, ADLS Gen2, ETL/ELT, and data modeling; hands-on incremental ingestion, orchestration, automated testing, and Spark performance tuning.
•  Required - Delivery: Practical Unity Catalog, secure Azure access, Git/CI/CD, monitoring, and recovery experience; ability to manage commitments and explain data quality issues to U.S.-based stakeholders.
•  Preferred - Additional Platforms: Experience with one or more: Azure Data Factory, Event Hubs, Structured Streaming, Lakeflow pipelines, Terraform, Microsoft Fabric, or Azure Synapse Analytics. Depth across all tools is not expected.
•  Preferred - Integration & Certification: Power BI integration or analytics data modeling is a plus. Relevant Databricks data engineering certification is preferred; equivalent practical experience is welcomed.
SKILLS :
Azure Databricks · ADLS Gen2 · SQL · Python/PySpark · Delta Lake · Unity Catalog · ETL/ELT · Orchestration · CI/CD · Performance Tuning

full_job_description:
Brief Description
Location: Technopark, Thiruvananthapuram
Experience: 0–1 year (final-semester students are also welcomed)
Employment Type: Full-time
Salary: 25-30 K per month
We are looking for a curious, research-oriented individual with a background in Psychology, Behavioural Science or Cognitive Science who can turn research findings into practical solutions.The role focuses on understanding how engineers think, feel and behave toward AI, identifying the barriers to AI adoption, and helping turn AI usage into a consistent daily habit.
A background in any one of these fields is sufficient; a combination of all three is not required. Mindset matters most.
We are looking for someone who does not stop at research or theoretical explanations. You should be able to translate findings into actionable interventions, help implement them, measure their effectiveness and draw clear, evidence-based conclusions.
Key Responsibilities
1. Behavioural Assessment – Psychology
Assist in designing and conducting behavioural assessments, including scoring and interpreting results using appropriate methods.
Identify the fears, doubts, beliefs and motivations that influence how different engineer personas respond to AI.
Help document behavioural patterns and translate assessment findings into actionable insights.
2. Understanding How People Think – Cognitive Science
Study how engineers learn, interact with and use AI tools in their daily work.
Explore when engineers trust, question, resist or ignore AI-generated outputs.
Identify patterns in learning, decision-making and problem-solving that influence AI adoption.
3. Behaviour Change & Intervention – Behavioural Science
Help design and implement persona-specific interventions to improve AI adoption.
Support experiments and practical initiatives that encourage consistent AI usage.
Track behavioural changes over time using observations, feedback and usage data.
Compare outcomes before and after interventions and recommend improvements based on the findings.
4. Research-to-Action & Reporting
Convert observations into clear hypotheses that can be tested using data.
Support the implementation of research findings
Document results, identify what works and what does not, and communicate clear, decision-ready conclusions.
Refine approaches when evidence shows that an intervention is not effective.
Educational Qualifications
A bachelor's or master's degree in any one of the following fields (Final-semester students from the above disciplines are welcome to apply.)
Psychology (Organisational, Applied, Cognitive, Counselling or any other specialisation)
Behavioural Science or Behavioural Economics
Cognitive Science
Added Advantage
Certification or coursework in behavioural science, behavioural economics, psychometrics or change management.
Research experience through a dissertation, thesis, academic project or publication.
Familiarity with surveys, behavioural assessments, qualitative research or basic data analysis.
Preferred Skills
Mindset & Skills
Research-to-Action Mindset
Curious: Looks beyond surface-level answers to understand why people trust, resist or ignore AI.
Hypothesis-driven: Converts observations into testable ideas and validates them using evidence.
Practical: Focuses on solutions that can be implemented in real working environments.
Action-oriented: Moves from findings to implementation without waiting for perfect information.
Evidence-driven: Relies on observed behaviour, feedback and usage data rather than opinions alone.
Outcome-focused: Measures results, draws clear conclusions and recommends the next steps.
Adaptable: Accepts when an approach does not work and changes direction based on evidence.
Essential Skills
Strong interest in human behaviour and willingness to learn behavioural assessment tools.
Basic Excel skills and comfort working with data.
Clear written and verbal communication in English.
Ability to explain research findings in simple, practical terms.

Brief Description
Position: NOC / SRE Lead – NOC Operations
Location: Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, India (Onsite)
Experience: 8+ Years
Employment Type: Full-Time
Department: Network Operations Center (NOC)
About the Role
We are seeking an experienced NOC / SRE Lead to own the health, observability, and incident response for a connected fleet of field-deployed systems and the data center infrastructure that supports it.
This is the keystone L3 role in our Network Operations Center (NOC). You will own deep diagnosis and root-cause analysis on the running system, command the hardest escalations, and build the standards, runbooks, observability architecture, and operator-certification program that the rest of the NOC inherits.
As the L3 Lead, you will act as the escalation point above L2 support teams, taking ownership of the most complex incidents while keeping escalations to L4 product engineering limited to genuine code and firmware issues — protecting both fleet uptime and engineering velocity.
This is a greenfield opportunity. In the near term, the role combines a hands-on L3 technical function with NOC leadership. As the NOC scales, the role is designed to grow into a Principal SRE or NOC Manager track.
Key Responsibilities
1. Fleet Health & Observability
Architect the monitoring stack the NOC runs on — scrape architecture, alert rules, dashboards, and SLOs — rather than only consuming it.
Own end-to-end visibility of the connected fleet across data center, edge Kubernetes, Linux, and network layers.
Continuously tune alerting to reduce noise and catch degradation early.
2. Data Center & Infrastructure Operations
Oversee the health and availability of data center and colocation infrastructure — compute, storage, network, power, and cooling dependencies — supporting the fleet.
Coordinate with data center operators, colocation providers, and remote-hands teams for physical interventions, maintenance windows, and capacity changes.
Manage hardware fault handling, RMA workflows, and site-level incident response across distributed data center and edge sites.
Coordinate with telecommunications providers, colocation partners, cloud vendors, and infrastructure service providers to resolve service-impacting issues and maintain operational continuity.
3. Incident Management & Response
Serve as incident commander on the hardest escalations, including Sev1/P1 incidents, and drive them to resolution within SLA.
Perform deep diagnosis and root-cause analysis on the running system using logs, metrics, and telemetry.
Diagnose complex issues across:
Network connectivity, routing, NAT/CGNAT, and tunnels
Degraded or intermittent links to field-deployed hardware
Production Kubernetes and Linux platform dependencies at the edge
Assume end-to-end ownership of major incidents, service disruptions, and customer escalations until resolution and formal closure.
Act as the highest operational escalation point within the NOC for complex technical and service- impacting incidents.
Provide timely updates to internal stakeholders, leadership teams, and customers during major incidents and service outages.
4. Standards, Runbooks & Operator Certification
Codify diagnostic procedures, escalation paths, and operational standards that make the NOC repeatable and scalable.
Own the operator-certification layer that qualifies operators to run and support the fleet.
Develop and continuously improve runbooks and operational procedures inherited by L1/L2 teams.
5. Escalation & Coordination
Maintain escalation hygiene: reserve L4 product engineering for genuinely complex issues requiring code or firmware changes.
Clearly define problem scope, business impact, and affected systems when escalating, with supporting logs and evidence.
Facilitate technical communication across engineering and operations teams during major incidents, providing timely stakeholder updates.
6. Continuous Service Improvement
Lead post-incident reviews and drive corrective actions to closure.
Identify recurring incidents and contribute preventive improvements and monitoring optimization.
7. Client & Stakeholder Engagement
Act as a primary technical point of contact for customers, partners, vendors, and internal stakeholders on operational and service-related matters.
Participate in customer meetings, operational reviews, service reviews, and technical discussions as a subject matter expert.
Provide clear, professional, and executive-level communication during major incidents, service disruptions, and operational escalations.
Build and maintain strong working relationships with customer technical teams while driving accountability and service excellence.
8. Leadership & Team Development
Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and guidance to L1 and L2 engineers.
Drive knowledge sharing, operational maturity, and continuous improvement initiatives across the NOC function.
Support the development and maintenance of operator certification programs and competency frameworks.
Participate in recruitment, onboarding, training, and capability development activities as the NOC organization scales.
Preferred Skills
Required Skills & Qualifications
8+ years in SRE, production engineering, or senior NOC roles with strong platform depth (not generalist IT-NOC).
Production Kubernetes and Linux experience, ideally in edge or distributed environments rather than pure cloud.
Ownership-level experience with Prometheus and Grafana — designing scrape architectures and alert rules, not just reading dashboards.
Hands-on experience with data center operations — running production infrastructure across data center, colocation, or distributed edge sites.
Strong practical networking: TCP/IP, NAT/CGNAT, tunnels, and degraded-link diagnosis.
Demonstrated on-call leadership and Sev1 incident command in production environments.
Proven ability to codify standards, runbooks, and certification programs for operations teams.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and documentation skills, with excellent communication across engineering and business stakeholders.
Strong ownership mindset with the ability to independently drive incidents, projects, and operational improvements to completion.
Ability to remain calm, structured, and decisive during high-severity incidents and customer escalations.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Experience interacting directly with enterprise customers, vendors, and senior stakeholders in operational environments.
Tools & Technologies
Observability & Telemetry:
Prometheus, Grafana, and related monitoring/alerting platforms
Platform:
Kubernetes, Linux (edge/distributed deployments)
Automation:
Infrastructure-as-Code tooling (advantage)
Incident & Collaboration:
Incident management, ticketing, and on-call platforms

Prior NOC/SRE experience supporting a hardware or field-deployed product.
Exposure to OT/BMS environments and comfort bridging IT and industrial systems.
Relevant certifications (Kubernetes, Linux, networking, or cloud) are an advantage.
Highly desired: Proven experience building or scaling a Network Operations Center (NOC) from the ground up, including monitoring strategy, runbooks, escalation models, operational processes, and team development.
Work Environment
Operates within a 24×7 Network Operations Center supporting a live fleet of field-deployed systems and distributed data center infrastructure.
